name: Antoni Gaudí
contribution: A Catalan architect and designer, widely known as the greatest exponent of Catalan Modernisme.

checks.lead: Antoni Gaudí i Cornet ( gow-DEE,  GOW-dee; Catalan: [ənˈtɔni‿ɣəwˈði]; 25 June 1852 – 10 June 1926) was a Catalan architect and designer, widely known as the greatest exponent of Catalan Modernisme. Gaudí's works have a sui generis style, with most located in Barcelona, including his magnum opus, the Sagrada Família church.
